ability_description: Evolved Archers gain +25% HP and 6.5-tile range. Enemies at 5-6.5 tiles (out of normal range) take a Power Shot dealing double damage.
Creates an 8x9 wind zone around itself that slows enemy troop movement speed by 30% and speeds up allied troops by 30%. Tied to the dragon's position; lingers ~2s after death.
Each hit grants a stacking Rage effect (~30-35% boost to hit speed/movement speed/damage) for 3 seconds. Evolved Barbarians spawn with ~10% higher HP than normal.
Every attack heals the attacking Bat via two 0.5s-interval healing pulses, allowing overheal up to 150% of base HP. Evolved Bats have +50% HP.
Deals area damage and pushback during its charge; bounces off its target on impact and repeatedly deals damage until destroyed. Stun effects (Zap, Ice Spirit, Electro Wizard) reset the charge.
Its bomb bounces 2 extra times after the initial impact, each bounce dealing full splash damage and covering ~2.5 extra tiles. +25% HP.
On deploy, fires 9 explosive projectiles in 2 rows (5 top / 4 bottom) dealing ~320 area damage total with knockback across a 2.5-tile radius per hit -- enough to wipe small swarms.
Hits leave a poisoned zone that deals continuing damage, escalating over 3 tiers with consecutive hits (~51 -> 115 -> 307 DPS), each poison lasting ~4s.

Its chain-lightning attack (normally 3 targets) becomes unlimited -- it keeps arcing to any target within 4 tiles of the last, at 33% less damage and 80% slower per hop after the first 3 targets, and no longer stuns past that point.
On the outgoing throw, enemies within 3.5 tiles of the axe's start are knocked back and take bonus damage. The bonus damage/knockback only applies on the way out, not on the return.
Its shots leave sparks that deal damage every 0.25s and slow enemies caught in them (Poison-like DoT), on top of the projectile splitting into 5 shrapnel pieces on impact.
While attacking, Fire Spirit spawn interval drops from 5s to ~2.4s (originally 1.8s before a balance change), alternating spawn sides of the Furnace each time.
Traps enemy troops inside the snowball and rolls them forward ~4 tiles before releasing/slowing them; affects troops of any weight, and trapped troops can't be targeted mid-roll.
A second barrel is thrown into the mirrored tile of the opposite lane, spawning 3 Decoy Goblins on landing -- forcing the opponent to react on both lanes.

Pulls a single enemy ground troop within 3 tiles into the cage, dealing damage over time until the cage or the trapped unit dies. Doesn't affect air/buildings/clones; jumping/dashing units are briefly immune.
Hides underground and resurfaces at a new spot near the tower at 66% and 33% HP (twice total), spawning 2 Goblins each time it resurfaces, plus 2 more on death.
Below 50% HP, spawns a knife Goblin every 1.5s from ~2.5 tiles behind itself, without any change to its own base stats.
Every 3rd deployment (2-cycle), throws a net that roots the nearest enemy troop (ground or air) in place -- unable to move or attack -- for 4 seconds.
On hitting a target, deals a delayed second freeze/damage blast ~3s later (splashing nearby enemies too), plus a slightly larger splash radius than the base card.

Its damage-ramp beam no longer resets to Stage 1 when switching targets, as long as a new target is found within 9 seconds -- damage escalates from ~88 DPS up to 2,110+ DPS the longer it stays locked on (across targets).
While not attacking, takes 60% less damage from all sources; the shield stays up until the Knight next deals damage.
On death, leaves behind an invulnerable, untargetable ghost that keeps fighting as long as it stays inside an active Rage effect -- vanishes once the Rage ends.
Every attack launches the target 4 tiles toward the nearest enemy Crown Tower (not just the jump-slam) -- effective for repeatedly displacing single tanks.
A Minion that takes a non-fatal hit becomes invisible and invincible for 3 seconds (untargetable, immune to Freeze/spells), at the cost of -33% move speed and -50% hit speed while active.
Hit speed ~25% faster and +20% HP; each shot also drops a Goblin at the landing site, adding extra sustained damage.

Fires 3 long-range sniper shots (up to 30 tiles, +50% damage each) at deploy that only hit troops/buildings, not Crown Towers directly; reverts to normal attacks against anything within 6 tiles or once the 3 shots are used.
Restores 12.5% of its own HP on every killing blow (troop or tower), and can overheal up to 150% of base HP.
Her 1st shot and every 3rd shot after (1, 4, 7...) fires a wider (3.0 vs 2.5-tile) icy arrow that slows enemies 30% for 7s; on death, leaves a frost burst that slows anything walking into it.
Spawns two extra invisible 'Souldier' ghosts (Skeleton-level HP/damage) each time it goes invisible; they don't despawn and inherit the same invisibility mechanic.
+10% HP, and every attack on a building also deals area damage + ground knockback in a 2.5-tile radius, giving it built-in swarm-clearing on top of its normal single-target hits.

Deploys airborne (untargetable by ground troops) and flies toward the nearest building, crashing down (small area damage) either on arrival or if hit while airborne, then continues as a normal Royal Hog on foot.
After its per-recruit shield (blocks one hit) is broken, that Recruit charges 2 tiles and deals 2x damage on impact -- Prince-style.
Every attack spawns an additional Evolved Skeleton, up to a max of 8 on the field from the original 3-4.
Defeated Skeletons leave behind untargetable, unlimited-HP shadow copies (still dealing damage) led by 'General Gerry' -- killing Gerry removes all remaining shadows at once.
Carries 2 barrels of 7 Skeletons each -- one drops at 75% HP, the second on death/arrival -- with +25% HP and +64% death damage versus the base card.
Emits an expanding circular shockwave (up to 6-tile radius) dealing damage and a 0.5s stun to everything caught in it; +20% HP.
Each axe swing creates a small tornado that pulls nearby ground and air enemies toward her while dealing bonus damage -- punishes units that try to stand at range around her.
On death/impact, explodes (reduced damage to towers) and spawns a 'Runner' per unit -- a low-HP, moderate-damage, building-targeting melee troop that keeps going on foot.

Heals ~109 HP (at tournament level) whenever a nearby Skeleton dies -- including Skeletons from Guards, Tombstone, Skeleton Army, and Skeleton Barrel, not just her own spawns. Can overheal up to 130% of base HP.
Gains a shield that blocks the first hit; when the shield breaks, pushback-vulnerable troops within 3 tiles are knocked back 3 tiles and take ~231 damage.
Zaps the same area 3 times at 1s intervals, with the radius expanding each time (2.5 -> 3 -> 3.5 tiles), each hit dealing the same damage/stun as a normal Zap.
